newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia signs $70 mln loans for GE's power.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia signs $70 mln loans for GE's power.

text.p: Tunisian state-run Societe Tunisienne de l'Electricite et du Gaz STEG has signed with a banking pool leaded by Union de Banques Arabes et Francaises UBAF four loans totalling $70 million to finance the building of a power plant, STEG officials said on Monday.
General Electric Co's General Electric International Inc last December won the contract for the building of the 240 megawatt gas fired power plant in Bir Mcherga, south-west of Tunis.
The loans include a purchasing loan garanteed by U.S.'s Exim Bank, a financial loan, and two purchasing loans from Italy and Austria.
The banking pool, led by UBAF, included Banque Nationale de Paris, Societe Generale, Credit Lyonnais, Bank of Austria, and the Paris-based Union Tunisienne de Banques.
